gloss: doing as one pleases; having one's own way

definitions.gloss: doing as one pleases; having one's own way
definitions.explanation: Acting freely without restraint or regard for others, often with a negative connotation of selfishness or lack of consideration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{好|す}き{放題|ほうだい}⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't let children do whatever they want.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{好|す}き{放題|ほうだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: He spends money however he pleases.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{好|す}き{放題|ほうだい}⟦やっていた→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{反省|はんせい}している→反省する：21398_hanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I did whatever I wanted when I was young, but now I regret it.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧ (liking, preference) and ⟦{放題|ほうだい}→放題：03151_houdai⟧ (as much as one likes, without limit). Carries a distinctly negative or critical nuance — used to describe behavior that is selfish, undisciplined, or excessive. Rarely complimentary.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {好|す}き{放題|ほうだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do as one pleases
- {好|す}き{放題|ほうだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say whatever one wants (without restraint)
- {好|す}き{放題|ほうだい}⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧: to do whatever one likes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{言|い}いたい→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{放題|ほうだい}→放題：03151_houdai⟧: saying whatever one wants (critical)
- ⟦{食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}→食べ放題：08291_tabehoudai⟧: all-you-can-eat (neutral, commercial) — uses the same ⟦{放題|ほうだい}→放題：03151_houdai⟧ pattern but without the negative nuance
- ⟦わがまま→わがまま：03789_wagamama⟧: selfish, willful — describes the personality trait rather than the behavior
- {勝手|かって}に: on one's own, without permission — focuses on acting without consent
